name: DIY wall bed + fold-down desk on a storage base
description: Self-built: low storage base (pillows, bedding), a board with an existing bed frame top + mattress that stands up against the wall and swings down onto gravity fold-out legs, and a desk hinged on the bed's underside with its own legs. Double-click the bed or desk: desk out → desk folded → guest bed. Both need a lock (bed up, desk folded) so nothing can fall.

source.notes: Mark's design; bed frame 140 x 190 (his existing frame top). Hinges, locks and legs are placeholders for real hardware.

baseHeight.description: storage base height = bed height when down

deskOffset.description: cm, desk centre along the wall (negative = towards the wall's start corner)
